mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline of >0.5% over the horizon, or the decline is not sustained for the full 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 6.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained labor market strength.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite UNRATE falling below 6.0% in the same month, or the rate drop is not sustained for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous cross above 12-month moving averages by both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days, signaling robust economic expansion.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 12-month MA and INDPRO crosses above 12-month MA
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO crossing above their 12-month moving averages in the same month, or the crosses are not simultaneous.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), compressed equity discount rates amplify risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns despite FEDFUNDS rising in a sustained tightening cycle, or the tightening is not maintained for the full 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GDPC1 above 14,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust demand, prompting investors to anticipate higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite GDPC1 crossing above 14,000 in the same month, or the peak is not sustained for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in labor demand (PAYEMS) and economic demand (GDPC1) above critical thresholds creates a positive feedback loop, driving S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 130311.0 and GDPC1 crosses above 16743.16
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite both PAYEMS and GDPC1 crossing above their thresholds in the same month, or the crosses are not simultaneous.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market activity (PAYEMS above 130,415) signals robust job growth, prompting investors to anticipate stronger corporate performance and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns despite PAYEMS remaining above 130,415 for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid expansion in supply capacity (INDPRO above 93.0) during an expansionary shock amplifies market liquidity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns despite INDPRO rising above 93.0 in the same month, or the expansion is not sustained for the full horizon.
